irrigation_pipelines.note: Pressurised irrigation pipelines from the station to a hydrant (給水栓) at each paddy; routes are not public.
irrigation_pipelines.pumps: 3 × φ700 mm (白山甚兵衛揚水機場); max supply 3.304 m3/s
sources: MAFF Kanto, Inbanuma Phase 2 main facilities (capacity)

lateral_collection.farm_drains: Farm drains have bare-soil beds: surface drainage seeps into the lateral layer and lateral flow enters the drains; both reach the pool (Okura et al. 2025 §4.2).
lateral_collection.pool: The pool is lined with concrete piles; lateral flow and groundwater enter through the seams, and small drainage pipes in the piles relieve pressure (Okura et al. 2025 §4.2).
lateral_collection.subsurface_drains: No public record of pipe underdrains (暗渠排水) in this district was found.
lateral_collection.model: cyclic.physics: Hooghoudt lateral drain flow with 10 m drain spacing and 0.8 m equivalent depth ('dense drain network, hence short L'); a per-paddy share of it is recaptured by the pool, set by distance to the nearest channel reaching the pool.
